label: Q-01
title: Phase 9.7's 'minter principal cleared from the legacy strategy' post-condition holds only in forge's simulation; on the broadcast chain 1.2e13 wei of minter principal stays on the de-registered legacy DOLA strategy
fingerprintVerified: re-derived by finding-manager as sha256(contract:function:rootCauseClass:entryPoint); matches verbatim
description: Story 089 requires the minter's DOLA collateral to move off the legacy (MockAutoDOLA) strategy. Phase 9.7 reads principalOf(minter) and passes that number to withdrawAsOwner, then require()s principalOf == 0. forge evaluates both during the simulation pass, where the whole run shares one timestamp, and bakes the amount (5000e18) into calldata. On the broadcast chain (anvil --block-time 2), MockAutoDOLA's time-based _updateYield runs between blocks, so ERC4626YieldStrategy._acquireShares (convertToAssets) credits 5000.000011999712006910e18 at the block-434 minter.mint. The block-436 withdrawAsOwner(5000e18) leaves 11,999,712,006,910 wei behind. The require never runs on chain.
impact: The local end state differs from what dev asserts and logs ('Phase 9.7 end state asserted'). The minter stays the sole principal holder on a strategy that SYA no longer lists and cannot withdraw from, so legacy totalBalanceOf(minter) = 3,299.64 DOLA (all mock yield, including simulate-yield's 2,300) accrues to an unreachable bucket. More broadly, it is a concrete instance where a simulation-time self-assert passes over time-dependent state while the chain diverges.
evidence: side-effects.json stateWrites (YieldStrategyDolaLegacy principal: block 435 = 5000.000011999712006910e18, block 436+ = 11999712006910) and postconditionResults; broadcast txs 433-436 (approve, PhusdStableMinter.mint 5000e18, MockDola.mint, withdrawAsOwner(minter, deployer, 5000e18)); dev-run.filtered.log line for Phase 9.7 shows principal 5000e18 in simulation.
attackPath: 1. npm run dev broadcasts DeployMocks on anvil --block-time 2.
2. In simulation, Phase 9.7 reads principalOf(minter)=5000e18 and bakes it into withdrawAsOwner calldata. The require(principalOf==0) passes against simulated state.
3. On chain, MockAutoDOLA's time-based yield accrues between blocks 434 and 436, so the minter's principal is 5000.000012e18 and the withdrawal leaves 1.2e13 wei.
4. The require never runs on chain.

classification.assetImpact: None of real value. On the local anvil chain, 11,999,712,006,910 wei (about 1.2e-5 DOLA) of mock minter principal stays on the de-registered legacy MockAutoDOLA strategy, and Phase 9.7 logs 'end state asserted' for a state the chain does not have. The 3,299.64 DOLA of legacy mock yield is stranded either way (story 089 already discloses the legacy yield seed as stranded locally).

classification.likelihood: certain on every dev run, but the effect is dust on a local mock
classification.assumptions: Local dev chain only. This is a separate entry point from any mainnet script, and the mainnet siblings of this pattern are tracked separately (78cb5942 fixed, 2c53e944 fix-pending).

justification: QA. The impact is dust on a local mock chain, with no mainnet path and no user funds. It is kept and not dropped, because it is one more instance of the ForgeLocalPassPrecedesBroadcast class (a script self-assert certifies simulated, time-dependent state that the broadcast chain does not reproduce), and that class has caused real issues on mainnet entry points. It is not a faithfulness deviation: story 089's review records the collateral move as going beyond the literal spec (Autonomous Decisions 3/4), so no story-stated behaviour is broken. The 2026-09-15 UI-mock ruling does not apply, because the problem is dev's own post-condition being false on chain, not a mock-vs-mainnet fidelity gap.
recommendation: Withdraw against the on-chain principal rather than a simulation-time number. Pass type(uint256).max (withdrawAsOwner caps to the available principal in AYieldStrategy._withdrawInternal), or principal plus a margin, and re-seed the deployer's actual DOLA delta. Alternatively, accept and log residual dust explicitly instead of asserting principalOf == 0.

dedup.reason: New instance of an established pattern. Same mechanism as stable-staker-v2-cutover L-09 78cb5942d4834f366ab7d5600a449c73bb8d43833dd8b822e25801d623e39cc6 (Phase 6b re-seeds a DOLA amount baked from forge local pass; status fixed) and promotion-ready M-01 2c53e944 (verification runs on simulated state; fix-pending). Different script/function and separate mitigation, so kept as its own finding, not merged. rootCauseClass normalized from candidate SimulationBakedAmountOverTimeDependentState to the ledger taxonomy class ForgeLocalPassPrecedesBroadcast (used by L-09 78cb5942) so the pattern groups. Not within the 2026-09-15 DeployMocks UI-mock ruling: it concerns dev violating its own Phase 9.7 self-assert on chain, not mock-vs-mainnet fidelity.
dedup.reviewFlag: Severity likely QA (1.2e13 wei on a mock chain); the classifier decides. Shares the symptom (3,299.64 DOLA stuck on legacy MockAutoDOLA) with DEV39-03 but the root cause and fix are different, so the two are not merged.
